select * from ( SELECT T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiNo, T2.ACCT_NAME acctName, T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO busiAcctNo, T1.VDATE vdate, t1.MDATE mdate, t1.TRADE_DATE settleDate, t1.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, decode(t1.trade_status,#{TRADE_STATUS_03},#{TRADE_FLOW_STATUS_03},#{TRADE_FLOW_STATUS_02}) tradeStatus, T1.CCY ccy, T2.BANK_DEP bankDep /*多级法人改造，增加STL_CAPACCT_INFO.BUSI_ACCT_NO查询字段 add by caojin 2020/6/12 start */ ,T2.SEQ_NO seqNo /*多级法人改造，增加STL_CAPACCT_INFO.BUSI_ACCT_NO查询字段 add by caojin 2020/6/12 end */ from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 ON T2.ACCT_NO = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T2.CCY = T1.CCY
T1.IS_CANCEL = #{IS_CANCEL_N} AND T1.BUSI_TYPE = #{BUSI_TYPE} AND EXISTS (select * from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T3 INNER JOIN PTL_TRADE T4 ON T4.BUSI_NO = T3.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T5 ON T5.PORTFOLIO_ID = T4.PORTFOLIO_ID where T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
AND ( T5.PROD_MANAGER IN
null) or T5.PROD_MANAGER in (
#{item} )
)
AND t1.MDATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startMDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{endMDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND T1.SETTLE_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startsettleDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{endsettleDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND (T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO in
null) or T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO in (
#{item} )
AND T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{busiNo},'%'))
)
AND tradeStatus = #{tradeStatus}

SELECT S.BUSI_ACCT_NO busiAcctNo, S.Acct_Name acctName, S.ACCT_NO acctNo, P.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, P.CCY ccy, PTL.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, VAL.TDY_INTINCEXP theoryTradeAmt, VAL.TDY_INTINCEXP actualTradeAmt, CASE WHEN (SELECT count(0) from PTL_PORTFOLIO PTL1 where PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL1.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END isParentPortfolio, S.BANK_DEP bankDep FROM PTL_CAPACCT_INFO P INNER JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO S ON P.ACCT_NO = S.ACCT_NO AND P.CCY = S.CCY INNER JOIN PTL_SEC_VALUTION VAL ON VAL.PORTFOLIO_ID = P.PORTFOLIO_ID AND VAL.FINPROD_ID = P.ACCT_NO AND VAL.CDATE = to_date(#{mdate},'yyyy-mm-dd')-1 INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD AD ON AD.PORTFOLIO_ID = P.PORTFOLIO_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FIN ON FIN.FINPROD_ID = AD.FINPROD_ID AND FIN.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE2_F16} INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PTL ON P.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID 1=1
AND ( S.BUSI_ACCT_NO IN
null) or S.BUSI_ACCT_NO in ( #{item} )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT *FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TOTAL WHERE TOTAL.FINPROD_ID = S.ACCT_NO AND TOTAL.MDATE = to_date(#{mdate},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TOTAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE2_F21} AND TOTAL.BUSI_TYPE = #{BUSI_TYPE_PTL03} AND TOTAL.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} AND TOTAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} )

select #{busiAcctNo} busiAcctNo, #{acctName} acctName, #{acctNo} acctNo, VAL.CCY ccy, P.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, P.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, VAL.TDY_INTINCEXP theoryTradeAmt, VAL.TDY_INTINCEXP actualTradeAmt, 'N' isParentPortfolio from PTL_SEC_VALUTION VAL INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO P ON VAL.PORTFOLIO_ID = P.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE P.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND VAL.CDATE = TO_DATE(#{mdate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') - 1 AND VAL.FINPROD_ID = #{acctNo} AND VAL.CCY = #{ccy} and nvl(VAL.TDY_INTINCEXP,0) > 0

SELECT DISTINCT S.BUSI_ACCT_NO id, S.ACCT_NAME text /*多级法人改造，增加STL_CAPACCT_INFO.BUSI_ACCT_NO查询字段 add by caojin 2020/6/12 start */ ,S.SEQ_NO seqNo /*多级法人改造，增加STL_CAPACCT_INFO.BUSI_ACCT_NO查询字段 add by caojin 2020/6/12 end */ FROM PTL_CAPACCT_INFO P INNER JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO S ON P.ACCT_NO = S.ACCT_NO AND P.CCY = S.CCY
INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO INFO
ON S.ACCT_NO = INFO.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO RATE ON RATE.CASH_ID = INFO.CASH_ID
1=1
AND (S.BUSI_ACCT_NO LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) OR S.ACCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')))
AND S.BUSI_ACCT_NO = #{initValue}
AND S.BANK_DEP = #{bankDep}

SELECT BUSI_ACCT_NO id, ACCT_NAME text FROM STL_CAPACCT_INFO S
AND (S.BUSI_ACCT_NO LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')) OR S.ACCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')))
AND (S.BUSI_ACCT_NO LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) OR S.ACCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')))
AND S.BUSI_ACCT_NO = #{initValue}
SELECT PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT ORDER_ID FROM STL_PAY_ORDERS
AND TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

select s.is_need_send isNeedSend, s.pay_type payType, s.settle_date settleDate, s.settle_amt settleAmt, s.ccy ccy, s.my_acct_no recAcctNo, c1.acct_name recAcctName, c1.large_payno recAcctPoint, s.counter_acct_no payAcctNo, c2.acct_name payAcctName, s.purpose purpose, s.remark remark, s.portfolio_id portfolioId, ptl.portfolio_name portfolioName, s.order_id orderId, s.settle_status settleStatus, s.is_total_trade isTotalTrade, s.ps ps from Stl_Pay_Orders s inner join trd_product_deal deal on s.trade_id = deal.trade_id left join stl_capacct_info c1 on s.my_acct_no = c1.acct_no and s.ccy = c1.ccy left join stl_capacct_info c2 on s.counter_acct_no = c2.acct_no and s.ccy = c2.ccy left join ptl_portfolio ptl on s.portfolio_id = ptl.portfolio_id 1=1 and deal.totle_trade_id = #{totalTradeId}
